What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based JavaScript engine that allows developers to create custom business applications and automate repetitive tasks. In the context of digital commerce, Google Apps Script can be used to automate product delivery, payment processing, and other business operations. This is particularly important for digital creators who need to manage orders, send download links, and process payments in a secure and efficient manner. With Google Apps Script, digital creators can take control of their online store and data ownership, eliminating the need for third-party platforms and their associated fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation involves several key components, including Google Drive for file storage, Gmail for sending download links, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. When a customer makes a payment, the NOWPayments webhook triggers the Google Apps Script backend, which then sends a download link to the customer via Gmail. Meanwhile, the product is stored on Google Drive, ensuring secure and efficient delivery. This architecture allows digital creators to automate product delivery and payment processing, reducing manual errors and increasing customer satisfaction.
